companyIntro.name: People First Partners
companyIntro.mission: Make hiring, pay and employee relations fair, compliant and efficient.
companyIntro.culture: Fair process, accurate records. People decisions are documented and explainable.

projectBackground.name: Pay Equity Review
projectBackground.context: Employees say pay is unfair. The board asks for facts and a plan.

manager.name: Agnieszka Nowak
manager.note: Pay decisions must be explainable. Show me the range, the market and the gap.

assignment.title: Test and fix pay fairness
assignment.brief: Calculate compa-ratio, range position and pay gap, assess employees in Excel and write the recommendation.

tasks.title: Compa-Ratio
tasks.prompt: Salary 52,000 and range midpoint 60,000. What is the compa-ratio (3 decimals)?
tasks.reasoning: Compa-ratio compares pay to the midpoint.
tasks.mistake: Dividing midpoint by salary inverts it.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Range Penetration
tasks.prompt: Range 48,000-72,000; salary 52,000. What is range penetration (%)?
tasks.reasoning: Penetration shows position within the range.
tasks.mistake: Using the midpoint instead gives a different measure.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Pay Gap
tasks.prompt: Women average 54,000; men 60,000. What is the pay gap (%) relative to men?
tasks.reasoning: Gap shows average difference, not equal pay for like work.
tasks.tip: Analyse by role and level too.
tasks.mistake: Confusing pay gap with equal pay claims.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Market Benchmarking
tasks.prompt: Why benchmark pay against the market?
options: To make sure pay is competitive and defensible
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Compa-Ratio Table (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Compa-ratio in column D = B / C.
tasks.mistake: Adjusting everyone below midpoint ignores performance.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Pay Recommendation
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence recommendation to the board.
tasks.modelAnswer: The average gender pay gap is 10% and several employees sit below 0.90 compa-ratio. I recommend a role-by-role equal pay analysis before any adjustment, then a targeted budget of €120,000 for justified adjustments. Employee 1 at 0.867 should be reviewed first, considering performance. We will publish the pay principles and report progress to the board in six months.
tasks.reasoning: A good recommendation separates analysis, action, budget and communication.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Quiet Pay Gap
caseStudy.background: A company found a 22% gap between similar roles after a whistle-blower. Back pay and legal costs exceeded €900,000.
caseStudy.solution: People First introduced pay ranges and annual equity reviews.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Fair pay needs ranges and reviews.

prompts: Which number would you trust least?
How do you explain pay to an employee?
What would you do first about the gap?
